summary: Advance your professional journey with our Certified Information System Audit Training. Equip yourself with the tools to conduct thorough and effective audits.
lede: Information systems auditing training helps IT auditors, security managers, consultants, and other IT professionals plan risk-based audits and assess controls. The course covers audit planning, IT governance, controls for systems acquisition and development, IT operations and support, and protection of information assets, with applied audit exercises and exam preparation aligned to the CISA syllabus.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals in the field of IT audit and governance.
audience: IT Managers/ Security managers/ IT Project Managers
modules: Domain 2 Governance and Management of IT
Domain 3 Information Systems Acquisition, Development and Implementation
Domain 4 Information Systems Operations, Maintenance and Support
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of IT systems and auditing principles.
